items.html: And this is a great rule with which you will understand everything: that always the second Partzuf is the upper half, as mentioned elsewhere. And since ZA, in the secret of the Ibur, was half a measure, she too was half a measure, for he is VAK, (and remained) and became three; and she is the seventh point, which is like the measure of his Yesod, the smallest of them all, which has only two joints (Perakin).
